items.title: Nanopore sequencing combined with adaptive sampling and NanoExpansion enables accurate characterization of repeat expansion disorders.
items.summary: Expansion repeat disorders are caused by abnormal expansions of short tandem repeats (STRs). We evaluated targeted long-read nanopore sequencing for comprehensive characterization of STR expansions in 132 participants, including patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1, n = 51) and DM2 ( n = 3) already characterized by Southern blot, C9orf72 -associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS n = 11) evaluated by repeat primed polymerase chain reaction (RP-PCR; validation group), suspected spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA, n = 46), cerebellar ataxia with neuropathy and vestibular areflexia syndrome (CANVAS; n = 13), Huntington's disease (1), Kennedy disease (1), Friedreich ataxia (FRDA, 2), and 4 healthy controls (test group). Native DNA was sequenced using adaptive sampling (AS) on Oxford Nanopore GridION or PromethION-2Solo platforms. Long-PCR sequencing was performed for comparison. We also developed NanoExpansion, a Python-based tool for sizing expanded alleles and detecting sequence interruptions. We correctly characterized all DM1, DM2, ALS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, and Kennedy disease cases, and identified eight SCA27B, two SCA37, three SCA31, one SCA3, and nine CANVAS cases. Compared with the AS approach, long-PCR underestimated alleles exceeding 800 repeats. Repeat interruptions were detected in 27/51 (52.9%) DM1 cases and 1/10 (10%) ALS, but not in CANVAS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, Kennedy disease, or SCA cases. This integrated sequencing analysis pipeline provides accurate, comprehensive characterization of repeat expansion disorders and has the potential to improve routine genetic diagnosis.
items.titleZh: 纳米孔测序结合自适应采样与NanoExpansion可实现对重复扩增疾病的准确表征
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了纳米孔长读长测序结合自适应采样和自研工具NanoExpansion，在132名参与者中准确表征多种重复扩增疾病，包括C9orf72相关ALS。结果显示该方法能正确识别所有ALS病例，并检测到重复中断；相比长PCR，其能更准确测量超长扩增。该流程有望提升常规遗传诊断的准确性。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者，该研究展示了纳米孔测序在C9orf72重复扩增检测中的高准确性，并能解析重复中断等精细结构，这有助于更精确的基因型-表型关联研究和临床遗传诊断。NanoExpansion工具的开源可能促进该技术在ALS遗传学中的标准化应用。

items.abstractZh: 重复扩增疾病由短串联重复序列（STR）的异常扩增引起。我们评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序在132名参与者中对STR扩增的全面表征能力，包括已通过Southern blot表征的强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1，n=51）和DM2（n=3）患者、通过重复引物聚合酶链反应（RP-PCR）评估的C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS，n=11；验证组）、疑似脊髓小脑共济失调（SCA，n=46）、小脑共济失调伴神经病和前庭反射消失综合征（CANVAS；n=13）、亨廷顿病（1例）、肯尼迪病（1例）、弗里德赖希共济失调（FRDA，2例）以及4名健康对照（测试组）。使用Oxford Nanopore GridION或PromethION-2Solo平台上的自适应采样（AS）对天然DNA进行测序。同时进行长PCR测序以作比较。我们还开发了NanoExpansion，一种基于Python的工具，用于确定扩增等位基因的大小并检测序列中断。我们正确表征了所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出8例SCA27B、2例SCA37、3例SCA31、1例SCA3和9例CANVAS病例。与AS方法相比，长PCR低估了超过800个重复的等位基因。在27/51（52.9%）的DM1病例和1/10（10%）的ALS病例中检测到重复中断，但在CANVAS、FRDA、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病或SCA病例中未检测到。这一整合测序分析流程可对重复扩增疾病进行准确、全面的表征，并具有改善常规遗传诊断的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究近期将纳米孔自适应采样测序与新型分析工具结合，提升了C9orf72相关ALS等重复扩增疾病的遗传诊断精度，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: Enzymatic N-deacylation is the predicted membrane-disruption switch for sphingomyelin: a falsifiable in-silico framework for sphingolipid vulnerability in ALS.
items.summary: Sphingolipid dysregulation is an emerging feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but no systematic method separates species that may worsen axon-myelin membrane integrity from matter that may counteract it. We present an in-silico framework classifying sphingolipids and designed derivatives as candidate membrane-disruptive or candidate protective species, scored against real biological referents using externally published tools rather than a bespoke composite. Its central finding concerns a single, chemically defined difference in lipid state. In coarse-grained (MARTINI 3) molecular dynamics with three independent replicates per system, intact palmitoyl-sphingomyelin is indistinguishable from a pure-POPC bilayer (leaflet-mean Δ thickness + 0.001 nm, 95% CI brackets zero), whereas the modeled N-deacylated form thins it in every replicate (Δ=-0.043 nm, [- 0.046, - 0.041]), tracking a lyso-phosphatidylcholine detergent control (-0.083 nm, [- 0.087, - 0.080]) on two concordant estimators. Because only one lyso-sphingolipid is parameterized in public MARTINI 3, N-deacylation is not established here as a class-wide effect. Across eleven ALS studies (2021-2026), six report elevated serine-palmitoyltransferase (SPT) pathway sphingolipids, all in monogenic SPTLC1/SPTLC2 cohorts, whereas sporadic cohorts show disturbance without a shared direction. Because the simulations do not address whether this species is produced, accumulates, or reaches pathological concentrations in ALS tissue, we present the ALS connection as hypothesis-generating rather than direct evidence. Separately, an explicitly exploratory arm reports two designed modulators with predicted target engagement (Boltz-2) and an ADMET triage of their liabilities. The primary contribution is the membrane result with a wet-lab panel that makes it falsifiable.

items.titleZh: 酶促N-脱酰化是鞘磷脂膜破坏的预测开关：一个用于ALS中鞘脂脆弱性的可证伪计算机模拟框架
items.summaryZh: 该研究用计算机模拟框架分析鞘脂对细胞膜的影响，发现鞘磷脂的N-脱酰化形式在模拟中会破坏膜结构，而完整鞘磷脂则不会。研究还回顾了ALS相关文献，发现单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列中SPT通路鞘脂升高，但散发性ALS无一致方向。作者强调这仅是假设生成，并非直接证据，并提出了可证伪的实验验证方案。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS中鞘脂代谢紊乱与膜完整性之间的机制联系提供了一个可证伪的计算框架，并明确区分了单基因与散发性ALS的鞘脂特征差异。其提出的湿实验验证面板有助于推动该假设向临床前研究转化，值得关注后续实验验证结果。

aiRead.keyFinding: N-脱酰化鞘磷脂在模拟中导致膜变薄，而完整鞘磷脂无此效应；单基因ALS队列中SPT通路鞘脂升高，但散发性ALS无一致方向。
aiRead.limitation: 模拟未验证该鞘脂种类是否在ALS组织中产生或积累；仅一种溶血鞘脂被参数化，不能推广为全类效应；ALS关联仅为假设生成。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续湿实验验证N-脱酰化鞘磷脂在ALS模型中的产生、积累及膜破坏效应，以及设计调节剂的靶点结合与安全性测试。

items.abstractZh: 鞘脂失调是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的一个新兴特征，但目前尚无系统方法将可能恶化轴突-髓鞘膜完整性的鞘脂种类与可能起对抗作用的物质区分开来。我们提出了一个计算机模拟框架，将鞘脂及设计衍生物分类为候选膜破坏性或候选保护性种类，并使用外部已发表的工具而非定制的复合评分，对照真实生物学参照物进行评分。其核心发现涉及脂质状态中一个化学上明确的单一差异。在粗粒化（MARTINI 3）分子动力学模拟中，每个体系进行三次独立重复，完整的棕榈酰-鞘磷脂与纯POPC双层膜无法区分（小叶平均厚度变化 +0.001 nm，95%置信区间包含零），而模拟的N-脱酰化形式在每次重复中均使其变薄（Δ=-0.043 nm，[-0.046, -0.041]），在两个一致估计量上均与溶血磷脂酰胆碱去垢剂对照（-0.083 nm，[-0.087, -0.080]）的变化趋势一致。由于公共MARTINI 3中仅有一种溶血鞘脂被参数化，N-脱酰化在此并未被确立为全类效应。在十一项ALS研究（2021-2026）中，六项报告丝氨酸棕榈酰转移酶（SPT）通路鞘脂升高，均来自单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列，而散发性队列显示紊乱但无共同方向。由于模拟并未解决该种类是否在ALS组织中产生、积累或达到病理浓度的问题，我们将ALS关联作为假设生成而非直接证据呈现。另外，一个明确探索性分支报告了两种设计调节剂具有预测的靶点结合（Boltz-2）及其ADMET风险分类。主要贡献是膜结果及使其可证伪的湿实验面板。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次提出酶促N-脱酰化作为鞘磷脂膜破坏的预测开关，为ALS中鞘脂脆弱性提供了可证伪的计算机模拟框架，具有机制探索和转化验证价值。

items.title: TBK1 overexpression reduces neuronal loss in the P497S UBQLN2 mouse model of ALS/FTD.
items.summary: Missense mutations in UBQLN2 are linked to dominant inheritance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) which is frequently accompanied by frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The encoded UBQLN2 protein functions to maintain proteostasis, collapse of which is increasingly being realized as the cause of many neurodegenerative diseases. During investigations of our UBQLN2 mouse models of ALS/FTD, we observed a significant decline in Tank-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) protein in end-stage mice. The decline could be significant, as haploinsufficiency of TBK1 expression is linked to ALS/FTD. To determine whether the reduction in TBK1 levels is responsible for driving pathogenesis, we crossed P497S UBQLN2 transgenic (Tg) mice with BacTBK1 Tg mice that overexpress TBK1 and analyzed the progeny for signs of pathology. The analysis revealed that double transgenic mice had a significant reduction in neurodegeneration in both the brain and spinal cord (SC) compared to P497S single-Tg mice. Double immunofluorescence staining of P497S mouse tissue revealed TBK1 colocalizes with UBQLN2 aggregates in spinal motor neurons. Biochemical extraction studies of mouse brain tissue revealed increased enrichment of TBK1 along with wild type and mutant UBQLN2 proteins in detergent-insoluble material, suggesting TBK1 gets sequestered by UBQLN2 aggregates. GST-pulldown assays revealed that UBQLN2 binds directly with TBK1, but paradoxically the P497S mutation was found to reduce TBK1 binding. Turnover studies indicated that loss of UBQLN2 destabilizes TBK1, providing another route for its reduction. These findings lead us to propose that efforts directed toward increasing TBK1 expression may provide a therapeutic approach for treating ALS/FTD caused by UBQLN2 mutations.
items.titleZh: TBK1过表达可减少ALS/FTD的P497S UBQLN2小鼠模型中的神经元丢失
items.summaryZh: 该研究在P497S UBQLN2转基因ALS/FTD小鼠模型中发现，终末期小鼠TBK1蛋白水平显著下降。将P497S小鼠与过表达TBK1的小鼠杂交后，双转基因子代在脑和脊髓中的神经退行性变明显减轻。机制上，TBK1与UBQLN2聚集体共定位并被隔离于去垢剂不溶性组分中；UBQLN2可直接结合TBK1，而P497S突变降低该结合；UBQLN2缺失还会使TBK1不稳定。作者据此提出，提高TBK1表达可能成为UBQLN2突变所致ALS/FTD的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该研究将TBK1单倍剂量不足这一已知ALS/FTD遗传学证据与UBQLN2突变模型中的蛋白稳态失衡直接联系起来，提示TBK1水平下降可能是UBQLN2相关ALS/FTD发病机制中的可干预节点。TBK1过表达在动物模型中减轻脑和脊髓神经退行性变，为后续验证TBK1通路作为治疗靶点提供了临床前依据，值得ALS研究者关注其向更接近人类疾病模型和转化研究推进的可能性。

items.abstractZh: UBQLN2的错义突变与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的显性遗传相关，且常伴有额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。所编码的UBQLN2蛋白功能在于维持蛋白质稳态，而蛋白质稳态的崩溃正日益被认为是许多神经退行性疾病的病因。在我们对ALS/FTD的UBQLN2小鼠模型进行研究期间，我们观察到终末期小鼠中Tank结合激酶1（TBK1）蛋白显著下降。这一下降可能具有重要意义，因为TBK1表达的单倍剂量不足与ALS/FTD相关。为确定TBK1水平的降低是否驱动了发病机制，我们将P497S UBQLN2转基因（Tg）小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1 Tg小鼠杂交，并分析子代是否存在病理迹象。分析显示，与P497S单转基因小鼠相比，双转基因小鼠在脑和脊髓（SC）中的神经退行性变均显著减少。对P497S小鼠组织的双重免疫荧光染色显示，TBK1与脊髓运动神经元中的UBQLN2聚集体共定位。对小鼠脑组织的生化提取研究显示，TBK1与野生型和突变型UBQLN2蛋白在去垢剂不溶性物质中富集增加，提示TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离。GST-pulldown实验显示UBQLN2与TBK1直接结合，但矛盾的是，P497S突变被发现会降低TBK1的结合。周转研究表明，UBQLN2的缺失会使TBK1不稳定，为其减少提供了另一条途径。这些发现使我们提出，旨在增加TBK1表达的努力可能为治疗由UBQLN2突变引起的ALS/FTD提供一种治疗途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，在UBQLN2突变相关ALS/FTD小鼠模型中证明过表达TBK1可减轻神经退行性变，为TBK1通路作为潜在治疗靶点提供了新的临床前转化依据。

items.title: Cellular senescence is an early feature and therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis TDP-43 Q331K mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the motor cortex and spinal cord. Aging is a key risk factor for ALS, and cellular senescence - a hallmark of aging marked by irreversible cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype - has been implicated in neurodegeneration, yet its role in ALS progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that molecular markers of cellular senescence emerge in the motor cortex and spinal cord alongside declines in neural and neuromuscular function in TDP-43 Q331K ALS mice, supporting senescence as an early feature of ALS pathology. To test whether reduced senescence ameliorates ALS pathology, we evaluated longitudinal senolytic treatment with dasatinib and quercetin (D&Q) in TDP-43 Q331K mice. D&Q treatment improved motor behavior, neuromuscular function, and reduced axonal damage as measured by plasma neurofilament light chain, accompanied by robust improvements in motor cortex excitability and preservation of layer V neuron counts. At the cellular level, cortical microglia were implicated as a potential mediator of senolytic benefits based on reduced microglial TDP-43 burden and senescence markers. Together, these findings identify cellular senescence as an early, disease-relevant, and modifiable feature of ALS pathology.
items.titleZh: 细胞衰老是肌萎缩侧索硬化TDP-43 Q331K小鼠的早期特征和治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠模型中发现，细胞衰老标志物在运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，并与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同步。使用达沙替尼联合槲皮素进行衰老细胞清除治疗，可改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能和运动皮层兴奋性，减少轴突损伤，并保留皮层V层神经元。皮层小胶质细胞可能是介导这些获益的关键细胞类型。研究提示细胞衰老是ALS早期、可干预的病理特征。
items.insight: 这项研究将细胞衰老定位为ALS的早期可修饰特征，并提供了衰老细胞清除药物在遗传性ALS小鼠模型中的纵向干预证据。其价值在于：一是将衰老生物学与TDP-43蛋白病直接联系，二是提示小胶质细胞可能是衰老细胞清除获益的介导者，三是使用血浆神经丝轻链作为轴突损伤的动态标志物，为后续转化研究提供了可追踪的终点。对ALS研究者而言，该研究为探索衰老靶向干预在ALS中的治疗窗口和生物标志物策略提供了临床前依据。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动皮层和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退变为特征。衰老是ALS的关键危险因素，而细胞衰老——一种以不可逆细胞周期停滞和促炎性衰老相关分泌表型为标志的衰老特征——已被认为与神经退行性变有关，但其在ALS进展中的作用仍不完全清楚。在此，我们显示，在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中，细胞衰老的分子标志物与神经和神经肌肉功能下降同时出现在运动皮层和脊髓中，支持衰老是ALS病理的早期特征。为检验减少衰老是否能改善ALS病理，我们在TDP-43 Q331K小鼠中评估了达沙替尼和槲皮素（D&Q）的纵向衰老细胞清除治疗。D&Q治疗改善了运动行为、神经肌肉功能，并减少了通过血浆神经丝轻链测得的轴突损伤，同时伴有运动皮层兴奋性的显著改善和V层神经元计数的保留。在细胞水平上，基于小胶质细胞TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物的减少，皮层小胶质细胞被认为是衰老细胞清除获益的潜在介导者。总之，这些发现将细胞衰老确定为ALS病理的一个早期、疾病相关且可修饰的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近将细胞衰老确立为TDP-43相关ALS的早期可修饰特征，并证明衰老细胞清除治疗在动物模型中改善功能与病理，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化潜力。

items.title: Mapping the evidence on dignity therapy in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a scoping review.
items.summary: Objective: To systematically map and synthesize the existing literature on the use of Dignity Therapy (DT) in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), with particular attention to feasibility, acceptability, therapeutic outcomes, and clinical adaptations required for patients and caregivers. Methods: A systematic scoping review was conducted searching PubMed/MEDLINE, CINAHL, PsycINFO, and Scopus for studies published in the last ten years examining DT in individuals with ALS. Eligible studies were charted and compared qualitatively due to heterogeneity in design, outcomes, and measurement tools. Results: A total of 237 records were identified, of which five met the eligibility criteria. DT was generally feasible in ALS, including in advanced disease stages, when adapted with augmentative communication devices, email correspondence, or videoconferencing. Acceptability was high across studies, with participants frequently reporting meaningful engagement with the narrative process and positive perceptions of the generativity document. Qualitative evidence indicated potential benefits in existential well-being, emotional adjustment, maintenance of identity, and family communication. Quantitative outcomes were inconsistent, showing variable effects on dignity-related distress, mood symptoms, and spiritual well-being. Caregiver responses were mixed, with some reporting perceived support and others noting limited immediate impact. Conclusions: DT appears to be a promising intervention for addressing existential and relational needs in ALS, though current evidence is limited by small sample sizes and methodological variability. Larger, methodologically rigorous studies are needed to clarify therapeutic effects, optimize delivery adaptations, and evaluate outcomes for both patients and caregivers.

items.titleZh: 绘制尊严疗法在肌萎缩侧索硬化中的应用证据图谱：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这是一项范围综述，系统检索了过去十年关于尊严疗法用于ALS的研究，最终仅纳入5项研究。总体来看，尊严疗法在ALS中可行且接受度较高，包括晚期患者通过辅助沟通设备、邮件或视频会议等方式接受治疗。定性证据提示可能改善存在性福祉、情绪调适、身份维持和家庭沟通，但定量结果不一致，对照护者的影响也不明确。作者认为现有证据样本小、方法差异大，尚需更高质量研究验证疗效并优化实施方式。
items.insight: 该综述提示尊严疗法在ALS中具有可行性和较高接受度，尤其通过辅助沟通、远程邮件或视频会议等方式可覆盖晚期患者，这对以患者为中心的心理社会照护具有参考价值。但纳入研究仅5项、样本小且方法异质，定量结局不一致，因此目前不能将其视为已证实的疗效干预。值得研究者跟踪的是：如何设计更大规模、方法学严谨的试验，明确尊严疗法对存在性痛苦、情绪和家庭沟通的效应，并同步评估照护者结局。

aiRead.keyFinding: 尊严疗法在ALS中总体可行且接受度高，定性证据提示可能改善存在性福祉、情绪调适、身份维持和家庭沟通，但定量结局不一致，照护者反应混合。
aiRead.limitation: 仅纳入5项研究，样本量小，研究设计、结局和测量工具异质性大，无法进行定量合并，疗效证据有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注更大规模、方法学严谨的临床试验，以明确尊严疗法对ALS患者及照护者的治疗效果，并优化辅助沟通、远程实施等适配方式。

items.abstractZh: 目的：系统梳理并综合现有关于尊严疗法（DT）用于肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的文献，特别关注可行性、可接受性、治疗结局以及针对患者和照护者所需的临床调整。方法：开展系统性范围综述，检索PubMed/MEDLINE、CINAHL、PsycINFO和Scopus中过去十年发表的、探讨DT用于ALS患者的研究。由于研究设计、结局和测量工具存在异质性，对符合条件的研究进行图表化整理并定性比较。结果：共识别出237条记录，其中5项符合纳入标准。DT在ALS中总体可行，包括在疾病晚期，当采用辅助沟通设备、电子邮件通信或视频会议进行适配时。各研究中可接受性较高，参与者常报告对叙事过程的有意义参与以及对生成性文档的积极看法。定性证据提示在存在性福祉、情绪调适、身份维持和家庭沟通方面可能获益。定量结局不一致，对尊严相关痛苦、情绪症状和灵性福祉的影响各异。照护者反应不一，部分报告感受到支持，另一些则指出即时影响有限。结论：DT似乎是应对ALS中存在性和关系性需求的一种有前景的干预措施，但当前证据受限于样本量小和方法学差异。需要更大规模、方法学严谨的研究来阐明治疗效果、优化实施适配，并评估患者和照护者的结局。
items.frontierRationale: 该范围综述新近系统梳理了尊严疗法在ALS中的有限证据，凸显了在晚期疾病中通过辅助沟通和远程方式实施心理社会干预的转化潜力，但尚需更高质量试验验证。

items.title: Combined rituximab and magnesium acetyl taurate therapy attenuates neurodegeneration via ERK/c-JNK/P38MAPK signaling modulation in methylmercury-induced amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-like neurotoxicity.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor neuron degeneration, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and dysregulation of intracellular signaling pathways. The present study investigated the neuroprotective potential of rituximab (RTXMB), alone and in combination with magnesium acetyl taurate (MACT600), against methylmercury (MLMC5)-induced ALS-like pathology in adult Wistar rats through modulation of the ERK/c-JNK/P38MAPK signaling pathway. ALS was induced by oral administration of MLMC5 (5 mg/kg) for 21 days. RTXMB (50 and 100 mg/kg) and MACT600 (600 mg/kg) treatments were administered from day 22 to day 42. Behavioral assessments, neurochemical estimations, ELISA, Western blotting, hematological analysis, gross morphology, and histopathological evaluations were performed. MLMC5 exposure produced significant impairments in locomotion, muscular strength, cognition, and emotional behavior, accompanied by increased oxidative stress, inflammatory cytokines, glutamate excitotoxicity, apoptotic markers, methylmercury accumulation, and dysregulation of ERK/c-JNK/P38MAPK signaling. Moreover, MLMC5 caused marked demyelination, neuronal degeneration, neurotransmitter imbalance, skeletal muscle damage, and hematological dysfunction. RTXMB treatment significantly attenuated these pathological alterations in a dose-dependent manner, with RTXMB100 showing greater neuroprotective efficacy. Combined administration of RTXMB100 and MACT600 demonstrated the most pronounced therapeutic effects by restoring antioxidant defenses, suppressing neuroinflammation and apoptosis, normalizing neurotransmitter levels, preserving myelin integrity, and improving neuronal morphology. The findings suggest that RTXMB, particularly in combination with MACT600, exerts potent neuroprotective effects against ALS-like pathology via modulation of MAPK signaling pathways and may represent a promising therapeutic strategy for ALS management.
items.titleZh: 利妥昔单抗联合乙酰牛磺酸镁通过调节ERK/c-JNK/P38MAPK信号通路减轻甲基汞诱导的肌萎缩侧索硬化样神经毒性中的神经退行性变
items.summaryZh: 该研究在甲基汞诱导的ALS样大鼠模型中测试了利妥昔单抗单用及与乙酰牛磺酸镁联用的效果。结果显示，利妥昔单抗可剂量依赖性地减轻行为、神经化学和组织病理学异常，而联合乙酰牛磺酸镁效果最强，其机制可能与调节ERK/c-JNK/P38MAPK信号通路有关。
items.insight: 该研究提示利妥昔单抗联合乙酰牛磺酸镁可能通过MAPK信号通路发挥神经保护作用，为ALS治疗提供了新的候选联合策略。但证据仅来自甲基汞诱导的动物模型，该模型并非ALS的遗传或散发性模型，其转化价值需进一步验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性、氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍及细胞内信号通路失调为特征。本研究在成年Wistar大鼠中，通过调节ERK/c-JNK/P38MAPK信号通路，探讨了利妥昔单抗（RTXMB）单用及与乙酰牛磺酸镁（MACT600）联用对甲基汞（MLMC5）诱导的ALS样病理的神经保护潜力。通过口服给予MLMC5（5 mg/kg）持续21天诱导ALS。RTXMB（50和100 mg/kg）及MACT600（600 mg/kg）治疗从第22天至第42天给药。进行了行为学评估、神经化学测定、ELISA、Western blotting、血液学分析、大体形态学及组织病理学评价。MLMC5暴露导致运动、肌力、认知和情绪行为显著受损，并伴有氧化应激增加、炎性细胞因子升高、谷氨酸兴奋性毒性、凋亡标志物增加、甲基汞蓄积及ERK/c-JNK/P38MAPK信号通路失调。此外，MLMC5引起明显的脱髓鞘、神经元变性、神经递质失衡、骨骼肌损伤及血液学功能障碍。RTXMB治疗以剂量依赖性方式显著减轻这些病理改变，其中RTXMB100显示出更强的神经保护效力。RTXMB100与MACT600联合给药表现出最显著的治疗效果，可恢复抗氧化防御、抑制神经炎症和凋亡、使神经递质水平正常化、保护髓鞘完整性并改善神经元形态。研究结果表明，RTXMB，特别是与MACT600联用，通过调节MAPK信号通路对ALS样病理发挥强效神经保护作用，可能代表一种有前景的ALS治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近探索了利妥昔单抗联合乙酰牛磺酸镁在ALS样神经毒性模型中的神经保护作用，并涉及MAPK信号通路调控，具有一定的ALS转化研究参考价值。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化症临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇发表于《Neurology》的观点文章，指出ALS早期和中期临床试验常被用来宣称疗效，但这些结果大多未能在3期试验中兑现，形成了“可信度差距”。作者认为，产业界与学术界激励错位催生的“临床试验工业复合体”助长了多种方法学和解读谬误，包括错误前提、生物标志物误用、设计与目标不匹配、选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签数据，以及对不确定结果的乐观包装。文章呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与假设检验、审慎描述结果，并更严格地筛选2期项目，以推动真正有效的ALS疗法开发。
items.insight: 这篇观点文章直接触及ALS试验领域长期存在的结构性问题：2期信号被过度解读为疗效证据，进而影响3期设计和患者预期。对ALS研究者而言，它提醒在解读NfL等生物标志物、开放标签扩展数据和事后分析时保持方法学警惕，并强调2期到3期的决策需要更严格的假设检验框架，而非依赖替代终点或探索性信号。这对试验设计、终点选择和结果传播具有直接的方法学参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 长期以来，肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）早期和中期临床试验数据被用来宣称临床获益，但这些宣称未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。文章指出，一个极大影响试验设计、数据解读和结果传播的“临床试验工业复合体”所产生的扭曲激励，正在助长错误的科学推理。反复出现的谬误包括：结局比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标之间的不匹配、结局的选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对无定论数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界激励错位的强化下，导致对治疗前景的过早宣称，并对患者造成实际伤害。为弥合由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度差距，我们呼吁严格遵循既有的临床试验结果报告标准，更清晰地区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更有纪律的分流。向科学怀疑精神和方法学严谨性的文化转变，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年发表，针对ALS临床试验可信度差距提出方法学改革呼吁，对当前ALS试验设计、生物标志物解读和2期到3期转化决策具有直接的前沿警示与转化规范价值。

items.title: [Effect of electroacupuncture at Jiaji (EX-B2) on disease progression in mice with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis based on NLRP3/Caspase-1/ASC signaling pathway].
items.summary: To explore the underlying mechanism of electroacupuncture (EA) at "Jiaji" (EX-B2) on the disease progression through modulating NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3)/cysteine-aspartic acid protease 1 (Caspase-1)/apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a caspase recruitment domain (ASC) signaling pathway in mice with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Forty-five mice carrying the human superoxide dismutase 1 G93A (hSOD1 G93A ) gene were randomly divided into a model group, a Jiaji EA group, and an inhibitor group, 15 mice per group. The other 15 mice without hSOD1 G93A gene carried were collected as a wild group. When the mice were aged 60 days, in the Jiaji EA group, EA was operated at "Jiaji" (EX-B2) of L 1 /L 2 , L 5 /L 6 , with continuous wave, a frequency of 2 Hz and an intensity of 1 mA, retained for 20 min, twice a week; in the inhibitor group, the intraperitoneal injection with NLRP3 inhibitor (10 mg/kg) was administered, twice a week. The interventions lasted for 4 weeks in each group. When the mice were aged 120 days, 9 mice in each group were randomly selected for tissue collection from lumbar spinal cord, and the disease progression and limb function were observed for the remaining 6 mice. The neurological function score was employed to assess the disease progression of mice in each group, and the gait experiment was conducted to observe the gait and stride length; HE staining was used to observe the motor neuron morphology in the anterior horn of the lumbar spinal cord, immunohistochemistry was used to detect the expression of ionic calcium-binding adapter molecule 1 (Iba-1) in the anterior horn of the lumbar spinal cord, and Western blot was used to detect the protein expression of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, interleukin (IL)-18 and IL-1β in lumbar spinal cord. Compared with the wild group, in the model group, the disease was worsened progressively, on days 90 and 120 after birth, the stride length of mice was reduced ( P <0.05, P <0.01), and the gait was unstable and dragging on 120 days after birth; the motor neurons in the anterior horn of the spinal cord exhibited obvious cellular edema and rupture, marked vacuolization and nuclear pyknosis, along with severe neuron loss; the expression of Iba-1 increased in the anterior horn of the lumbar spinal cord ( P <0.01), colored dark brown and densely aggregated; and the protein expression of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-18, IL-1β in lumbar spinal cord was up-regulated ( P <0.01). When compared with the model group, in the inhibitor group and the Jiaji EA group, the onset of paresis and the progression of paralysis were delayed and the survival rates increased ( P <0.01); stride length was larger in the mice at the age of 120 d ( P <0.01); more clear gait was presented, and the ages in days was significantly delayed for gait dragging; the improvements were exhibited in the degree of edema, vacuolization, and nuclear pyknosis observed in the motor neurons of the anterior horn of the lumbar spinal cord; the expression of Iba-1 was reduced in the anterior horn of the lumbar spinal cord ( P <0.01), appearing gray-brown, and scattered clusters in small number; and the protein expression of NLRP3, Caspase-1, ASC, IL-18, and IL-1β in lumbar spinal cord was decreased ( P <0.05, P <0.01). The protein expression of NLRP3, Caspase-1 and IL-18 in lumbar spinal cord in the Jiaji EA group was up-regulated in comparison with that in the inhibitor group ( P <0.05). Electroacupuncture at "Jiaji" (EX-B2) can delay the disease progression in mice with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, which may be related to modulating NLRP3/Caspase-1/ASC signaling pathway and inhibiting the inflammatory response, thereby attenuating the inflammatory injury of lumbar spinal cord. 目的： 探讨夹脊电针调控NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）/半胱天冬酶1（Caspase-1）/凋亡相关斑点样蛋白（ASC）信号通路对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）小鼠疾病进展影响的可能作用机制。 方法： 将45只携带人超氧化物歧化酶1 G93A（hSOD1 G93A ）基因的小鼠随机分为模型组、夹脊电针组和抑制剂组，每组15只，取15只不携带hSOD1 G93A 基因的小鼠作为野生组。在各组小鼠60日龄时，夹脊电针组给予电针L 1 /L 2 、L 5 /L 6 夹脊穴，选用连续波，频率2 Hz，电流1 mA，留针20 min，每周2次；抑制剂组给予小鼠腹腔注射NLRP3抑制剂（10 mg/kg），每周2次。各组均连续干预4周。在小鼠120日龄时，每组随机选9只小鼠取腰髓组织，剩余6只继续观察疾病进展和肢体功能。采用神经功能评分评估小鼠疾病进展；步态实验观察小鼠步态、步幅；HE染色观察小鼠腰髓前角运动神经元形态；免疫组化法检测小鼠腰髓前角离子钙结合衔接分子1（Iba-1）表达；Western blot法检测小鼠腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、白细胞介素（IL）-18、IL-1β蛋白表达。 结果： 与野生组比较，模型组小鼠疾病进行性加重；90日龄、120日龄时步幅均缩小（ P <0.05， P <0.01），120日龄时步态不清、有明显拖拽；腰髓前角运动神经元水肿、破裂明显，空泡化、核固缩显著，神经元丢失严重；腰髓前角Iba-1表达增加（ P <0.01），呈深褐色，大量聚集；腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、IL-18、IL-1β蛋白表达升高（ P <0.01）。与模型组比较，抑制剂组和夹脊电针组小鼠轻瘫发病、瘫痪发生进展延缓（ P <0.01），生存比例升高（ P <0.01）；120日龄时步幅均增加（ P <0.01），步态更加清晰，步态拖拽日龄明显延后；腰髓前角运动神经元水肿程度、空泡化、核固缩现象改善；腰髓前角Iba-1表达降低（ P <0.01），呈灰褐色，少量散在分布；腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、IL-18、IL-1β蛋白表达降低（ P <0.05， P <0.01）。与抑制剂组比较，夹脊电针组小鼠腰髓NLRP3、Caspase-1、IL-18蛋白表达升高（ P <0.05）。 结论： 夹脊电针能够延缓ALS小鼠疾病进展，其机制可能与调控NLRP3/Caspase-1/ASC信号通路，抑制炎症反应而减轻小鼠腰髓神经炎症损伤有关。.
items.titleZh: 基于NLRP3/Caspase-1/ASC信号通路探讨夹脊电针对肌萎缩侧索硬化症小鼠疾病进展的影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究在hSOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型中观察夹脊电针的作用。结果显示，电针干预可延缓轻瘫发病和瘫痪进展、提高生存比例、改善步态与步幅，并减轻腰髓前角运动神经元水肿、空泡化和核固缩；同时降低腰髓Iba-1表达及NLRP3、Caspase-1、ASC、IL-18、IL-1β蛋白水平。作者认为其机制可能与调控NLRP3/Caspase-1/ASC通路、抑制神经炎症有关。
items.insight: 这项研究把ALS中备受关注的NLRP3炎症小体通路与夹脊电针干预联系起来，提供了行为学、组织形态和分子表达的多层面动物实验证据。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示神经炎症小体通路可作为干预靶点，并为非药物神经调控手段的机制验证提供参考；但结果来自SOD1 G93A小鼠，尚不能直接外推到ALS患者。

items.title: History of Head Injury and Risk of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: An Updated Comprehensive Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis of 5,033,215 Participants.
items.summary: Head injury has been proposed as a potential modifiable risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS); however, prior studies have yielded inconsistent findings. We aimed to re-evaluate this association through an updated systematic review and meta-analysis, incorporating the latest evidence and exploring the influence of injury severity, frequency, timing, and definition. A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, EBSCO, and ProQuest from inception to January 2026 was conducted. Observational studies (cohort and case-control) reporting the association between head injury and ALS risk were included. Pooled effect estimates were generated using random-effects models. Subgroup, sensitivity, cumulative, and publication bias analyses were performed. Twenty-nine studies encompassing 5,033,215 participants were included. These comprised 22 case-control studies and seven cohort studies. Case-control meta-analysis showed that head injury was associated with 36% higher odds of ALS (AOR = 1.36; 95% CI: 1.24-1.48; I² = 20.4%). Cohort studies showed a positive but non-significant association (RR = 1.59; 95% CI: 0.93-2.71). Subgroup analyses showed significant associations within mild, moderate, and severe injury categories and among studies with clearly defined traumatic brain injury exposure. Single head injury was associated with higher odds of ALS (AOR = 1.22; 95% CI: 1.11-1.34). Head injury was associated with an increased risk of ALS across multiple analyses, including different injury severity levels and exposure definitions. However, the observational nature of available evidence and the possibility of reverse causation and residual confounding limit causal interpretation. Further prospective studies and mechanistic investigations are required to clarify the potential relationship between head injury and ALS development.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（系统综述与荟萃分析）
items.titleZh: 头部损伤史与肌萎缩侧索硬化风险：纳入5,033,215名参与者的更新版综合系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项更新版系统综述与荟萃分析纳入29项观察性研究、超过500万参与者，发现头部损伤与ALS风险升高相关：病例对照研究合并比值比为1.36，队列研究风险比为1.59但未达统计学显著性。单次头部损伤也与风险升高相关。由于研究均为观察性设计，无法排除反向因果和残余混杂，因此不能推断因果关系。
items.insight: 该研究是目前关于头部损伤与ALS关联的最大规模荟萃分析，为“头部损伤作为ALS可改变危险因素”这一假说提供了迄今最全面的流行病学证据。尽管观察性设计限制因果推断，但其结果支持将头部损伤史纳入ALS风险分层和未来前瞻性队列设计，并提示需要机制研究探索创伤后神经退行性变的生物学通路。

aiRead.keyFinding: 头部损伤与ALS风险升高相关，病例对照研究合并AOR为1.36（95% CI 1.24-1.48），队列研究RR为1.59但无统计学显著性；单次头部损伤AOR为1.22。
aiRead.limitation: 纳入研究均为观察性设计，存在反向因果和残余混杂可能，无法确立因果关系；队列研究结果未达统计学显著性。
aiRead.watchNext: 未来需开展前瞻性队列研究和机制研究，以明确头部损伤与ALS发生之间的因果关系及生物学通路。

items.abstractZh: 头部损伤被认为是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）潜在的可改变危险因素；然而，既往研究结果不一致。我们旨在通过更新版系统综述与荟萃分析重新评估这一关联，纳入最新证据并探讨损伤严重程度、频率、时间及定义的影响。系统检索了PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Embase、EBSCO和ProQuest，检索时间从建库至2026年1月。纳入报告头部损伤与ALS风险关联的观察性研究（队列研究和病例对照研究）。采用随机效应模型生成合并效应估计值。进行了亚组分析、敏感性分析、累积分析和发表偏倚分析。共纳入29项研究，涵盖5,033,215名参与者，包括22项病例对照研究和7项队列研究。病例对照研究的荟萃分析显示，头部损伤与ALS风险增加36%相关（AOR = 1.36；95% CI：1.24-1.48；I² = 20.4%）。队列研究显示正相关但无统计学显著性（RR = 1.59；95% CI：0.93-2.71）。亚组分析显示，在轻度、中度和重度损伤类别中以及在创伤性脑损伤暴露定义明确的研究中均存在显著关联。单次头部损伤与ALS风险增加相关（AOR = 1.22；95% CI：1.11-1.34）。在多项分析中，包括不同损伤严重程度和暴露定义，头部损伤均与ALS风险增加相关。然而，现有证据的观察性性质以及反向因果和残余混杂的可能性限制了因果解释。需要进一步的前瞻性研究和机制研究来阐明头部损伤与ALS发生之间的潜在关系。
items.frontierRationale: 这项2026年发表的更新版荟萃分析整合了超过500万参与者的最新证据，强化了头部损伤与ALS风险的关联信号，对ALS可改变危险因素的识别和转化研究具有重要参考价值。

items.source: Journal of hospice and palliative nursing : JHPN : the official journal of the Hospice and Palliative Nurses Association
items.title: The Impact of Neuropalliative Care on Caregivers of Individuals with Motor Neuron Disorders or Atypical Parkinsonism.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative disorders, including motor neuron disease (MND) and atypical parkinsonism (AP), progress rapidly and place substantial physical, emotional, and financial strain on family caregivers who often provide complex care with limited support. Neuropalliative care (NPC) offers interdisciplinary, noncurative services aimed at improving quality of life (QoL), yet it is underutilized and often misunderstood. Employing Ferrans and Powers QoL Model, this study used an exploratory descriptive qualitative design to examine the experiences of 10 family caregivers of individuals with MND and AP receiving NPC at a specialized clinic. Thematically analyzed semi-structured interviews produced 4 themes that were identified: (1) caregiver QoL, (2) caregiver burden, (3) support, and (4) system barriers. Caregivers described significant emotional and physical strain, loss of personal time, and financial pressures. Clinic services such as anticipatory guidance, interdisciplinary support, and resource navigation were valued; however, many caregivers were unaware they were receiving NPC. Caregivers of individuals with MND reported broader access to resources than those supporting individuals with AP, who experienced more systemic barriers. Findings emphasize the need for earlier NPC integration; increasing awareness of services provided, improving caregiver education, and ensuring equitable access. These steps are necessary for enhancing caregiver well-being and optimizing care outcomes in this population.
items.titleZh: 神经姑息治疗对运动神经元疾病或非典型帕金森综合征患者照护者的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究访谈了10名运动神经元疾病或非典型帕金森综合征患者的家庭照护者，发现他们承受显著的身心与经济负担，且许多人并未意识到自己正在接受神经姑息治疗。研究识别出四个主题：照护者生活质量、照护者负担、支持和系统障碍。运动神经元疾病照护者比非典型帕金森综合征照护者获得更多资源，后者面临更多系统性障碍。研究呼吁更早整合神经姑息治疗、提高服务知晓度、改善照护者教育并确保公平可及。
items.insight: 该研究从照护者视角揭示了神经姑息治疗在运动神经元疾病中的实际落地障碍，尤其是服务知晓度低和资源分配不均的问题。对于ALS研究者而言，这提示在推进疾病修饰治疗的同时，需同步关注照护者支持体系的早期整合与公平可及，否则可能影响整体照护结局和临床试验中的依从性。

aiRead.studyType: 探索性描述性定性研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 照护者承受显著身心与经济负担，且多数未意识到正在接受神经姑息治疗；MND照护者资源可及性优于AP照护者。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量小（10名照护者），单中心，定性设计无法推广或确立因果关系。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注更大样本、多中心研究，以及早期整合神经姑息治疗对照护者结局和患者照护质量的影响。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病，包括运动神经元疾病（MND）和非典型帕金森综合征（AP），进展迅速，给家庭照护者带来沉重的身体、情感和经济负担，他们往往在支持有限的情况下提供复杂的照护。神经姑息治疗（NPC）提供跨学科的、非治愈性服务，旨在改善生活质量（QoL），但其利用率不足且常被误解。本研究采用Ferrans和Powers生活质量模型，运用探索性描述性定性设计，考察了10名在专科诊所接受NPC的MND和AP患者的家庭照护者的经历。对半结构化访谈进行主题分析后，确定了4个主题：（1）照护者生活质量，（2）照护者负担，（3）支持，（4）系统障碍。照护者描述了显著的情感和身体压力、个人时间的丧失以及经济压力。诊所服务如预期性指导、跨学科支持和资源导航受到重视；然而，许多照护者并不知道他们正在接受NPC。MND患者的照护者报告获得资源的途径比支持AP患者的照护者更广泛，后者经历了更多的系统性障碍。研究结果强调需要更早地整合NPC；提高对所提供服务的认识，改善照护者教育，并确保公平可及。这些步骤对于提高照护者福祉和优化该人群的照护结果至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近关注神经姑息治疗在运动神经元疾病照护者中的实施障碍，虽非疗效验证，但为改善ALS综合照护和照护者支持提供了转化方向。

items.title: CRISPR/Cas9-based nanodelivery systems for precision gene editing in neuroinflammation.
items.summary: Neuroinflammation is a characteristic feature of many neurological diseases, such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Uncontrolled activation of microglia and astrocytes results in the production of proinflammatory mediators that contribute to neuronal dysfunction and degeneration. CRISPR/Cas9 genome-editing technology provides highly precise targeting of genes involved in these pathways, enabling the deletion, correction, or modulation of disease-associated genetic alterations. Nonetheless, effective delivery of CRISPR components to the central nervous system (CNS) remains a major challenge because of protective barriers such as the blood-brain barrier (BBB), as well as concerns regarding genomic instability and immunogenicity. Nanotechnology-guided delivery platforms, such as lipid nanoparticles, liposomes, dendrimers and polymeric carriers, have been developed as promising strategies to address these challenges. These nanosystems can improve biodistribution, pharmacokinetic behavior, and cellular uptake, while potentially reducing off-target effects and systemic toxicity. The preclinical studies demonstrate successful modulation of key neuroinflammatory targets, including the NLRP3 inflammasome, triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2 (TREM2), Janus kinase (JAK) signaling, and the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway, with potential therapeutic relevance to neurodegenerative diseases. In addition, novel techniques, such as mitochondrial base editing, prime editing, and epigenetic modulation, expand the scope of CRISPR-mediated therapeutic strategies. Although outcomes from animal models are promising, translation to the clinical setting requires careful consideration of safety, ethical concerns, and long-term efficacy. This review highlights the potential of integrating CRISPR/Cas9 with nanodelivery systems to advance precision medicine for neuroinflammatory disorders, while emphasizing their potential for therapeutic applications in complex CNS conditions. Ongoing studies aimed at optimizing delivery and reducing off-target effects will be essential for advancing these approaches toward clinical practice.
items.titleZh: 基于CRISPR/Cas9的纳米递送系统用于神经炎症的精准基因编辑
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统总结了利用纳米递送系统（如脂质纳米颗粒、脂质体、树枝状聚合物等）将CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑工具递送至中枢神经系统以调控神经炎症的研究进展。文章指出，神经炎症是ALS等多种神经退行性疾病的共同特征，而CRISPR/Cas9可精准靶向NLRP3炎症小体、TREM2、JAK信号通路和cGAS-STING通路等关键神经炎症靶点。临床前研究已证明这些策略可成功调控上述靶点，但向临床转化仍面临血脑屏障递送效率、基因组稳定性、免疫原性、安全性和伦理等挑战。文章还提及线粒体碱基编辑、先导编辑和表观遗传调控等新技术可拓展治疗策略范围。
items.insight: 该综述将CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑与纳米递送技术整合，为ALS等神经退行性疾病中神经炎症的精准干预提供了系统性框架。其价值在于：一是明确列出了NLRP3、TREM2、JAK、cGAS-STING等可用于ALS神经炎症干预的分子靶点；二是梳理了脂质纳米颗粒、脂质体、树枝状聚合物等递送平台在跨越血脑屏障方面的潜力与局限；三是提示线粒体碱基编辑、先导编辑等新一代编辑工具可能进一步拓展治疗边界。对于关注ALS神经炎症机制和基因治疗递送策略的研究者，该文提供了当前临床前证据的整合视图和转化瓶颈的清晰梳理。

aiRead.keyFinding: 纳米递送系统（脂质纳米颗粒、脂质体、树枝状聚合物、聚合物载体等）可改善CRISPR/Cas9组件向中枢神经系统的递送，临床前研究已成功调控NLRP3炎症小体、TREM2、JAK信号通路和cGAS-STING通路等神经炎症靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 证据均来自临床前研究，向临床转化仍面临血脑屏障递送效率、基因组不稳定性、免疫原性、安全性和伦理等挑战，长期疗效尚不明确。

items.abstractZh: 神经炎症是许多神经系统疾病的特征性表现，如阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化。小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的失控激活导致促炎介质的产生，进而促进神经元功能障碍和变性。CRISPR/Cas9基因组编辑技术可对这些通路中涉及的基因进行高度精准的靶向，从而实现对疾病相关遗传改变的删除、纠正或调控。然而，由于血脑屏障等保护性屏障的存在，以及基因组不稳定性和免疫原性方面的担忧，将CRISPR组件有效递送至中枢神经系统仍是一项重大挑战。纳米技术引导的递送平台，如脂质纳米颗粒、脂质体、树枝状聚合物和聚合物载体，已被开发为解决这些挑战的有前景的策略。这些纳米系统可以改善生物分布、药代动力学行为和细胞摄取，同时可能减少脱靶效应和全身毒性。临床前研究证明，成功调控了关键神经炎症靶点，包括NLRP3炎症小体、髓系细胞触发受体2（TREM2）、Janus激酶（JAK）信号通路以及环鸟苷酸-腺苷酸合成酶-干扰素基因刺激因子（cGAS-STING）通路，这些靶点对神经退行性疾病具有潜在的治疗相关性。此外，线粒体碱基编辑、先导编辑和表观遗传调控等新技术拓展了CRISPR介导治疗策略的范围。尽管动物模型的结果令人鼓舞，但向临床转化需要仔细考虑安全性、伦理问题和长期疗效。本综述强调了将CRISPR/Cas9与纳米递送系统整合以推进神经炎症性疾病精准医学的潜力，同时强调了其在复杂中枢神经系统疾病中治疗应用的潜力。旨在优化递送和减少脱靶效应的持续研究对于将这些方法推向临床实践至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统整合了CRISPR/Cas9纳米递送系统在神经炎症中的最新临床前进展，直接关联ALS等神经退行性疾病的精准基因治疗转化方向。

items.title: Carbon dot-based nanomaterials in neurodegeneration: addressing neurobiological barriers and targeting challenges.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, represent a major global health challenge due to their progressive nature and limited therapeutic options. One of the primary obstacles to treating these disorders is the blood-brain barrier (BBB), which restricts the delivery of most therapeutic agents into the central nervous system. In recent years, carbon-based nanomaterials, particularly carbon dot (CD) nanostructures, have emerged as promising platforms for neurological applications owing to their ultrasmall size, BBB-crossing ability, and anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties, in addition to tunable surface chemistry, strong photoluminescence, and favorable biocompatibility. This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent research developments in the application of CD-based nanomaterials, including carbon nanodots, carbon quantum dots, graphene quantum dots, and carbon polymer dots, for the potential treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. The synthesis strategies and carbonization approaches used to produce these carbon nanomaterials are discussed, along with their physicochemical properties relevant to neurobiological applications, such as particle size, surface functionalization, heteroatom doping, optical properties, and stability in biological environments. Furthermore, the mechanisms by which CD-based nanomaterials can traverse the BBB are examined, including receptor-mediated and adsorptive-mediated transcytosis pathways. In addition, their applications are discussed, with particular focus on their roles in bioimaging, biosensing, inhibition of pathological protein aggregation, antioxidative activity, and targeted drug delivery. Finally, key challenges related to toxicity, biodistribution, large-scale synthesis, and clinical translation are discussed, along with future perspectives for the development of multifunctional theranostic platforms. Overall, use of CD-based nanomaterials represents a promising emerging strategy for overcoming neurobiological barriers and enabling the development of next-generation nanotherapeutics for the management of neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: 碳点基纳米材料在神经退行性疾病中的应用：应对神经生物学屏障与靶向挑战
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统总结了碳点基纳米材料（包括碳纳米点、碳量子点、石墨烯量子点和碳聚合物点）在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病中的潜在应用。文章重点讨论了这些材料如何穿越血脑屏障、其合成与理化性质、在生物成像、生物传感、抑制蛋白聚集、抗氧化和靶向递送中的作用，以及毒性、生物分布和临床转化等挑战。
items.insight: 该综述聚焦于碳点纳米材料穿越血脑屏障的机制及在神经退行性疾病中的多功能应用，为ALS及其他神经退行性疾病的药物递送和诊疗一体化提供了纳米技术视角。尽管目前仍处于临床前阶段，但其对血脑屏障克服策略和靶向递送的梳理，值得关注纳米治疗方向的ALS研究者跟踪。

aiRead.keyFinding: 碳点基纳米材料具有超小尺寸、穿越血脑屏障能力、抗炎和神经保护特性，可作为神经退行性疾病潜在诊疗平台。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，未提供原始临床或动物实验数据；碳点纳米材料的毒性、生物分布、大规模合成和临床转化仍面临挑战。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注碳点纳米材料在ALS模型中的血脑屏障穿越效率、靶向递送验证及长期安全性评估的后续研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病，包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，因其进行性特征和有限的治疗选择，构成了重大的全球健康挑战。治疗这些疾病的主要障碍之一是血脑屏障，它限制了大多数治疗药物进入中枢神经系统。近年来，碳基纳米材料，特别是碳点纳米结构，因其超小尺寸、穿越血脑屏障的能力、抗炎和神经保护特性，以及可调控的表面化学、强光致发光和良好的生物相容性，已成为神经应用中有前景的平台。本综述全面概述了碳点基纳米材料（包括碳纳米点、碳量子点、石墨烯量子点和碳聚合物点）在神经退行性疾病潜在治疗中应用的最新研究进展。讨论了用于生产这些碳纳米材料的合成策略和碳化方法，以及其与神经生物学应用相关的理化性质，如粒径、表面功能化、杂原子掺杂、光学性质和生物环境中的稳定性。此外，还探讨了碳点基纳米材料穿越血脑屏障的机制，包括受体介导和吸附介导的转胞吞途径。另外，讨论了其应用，特别关注其在生物成像、生物传感、抑制病理性蛋白聚集、抗氧化活性和靶向药物递送中的作用。最后，讨论了与毒性、生物分布、大规模合成和临床转化相关的关键挑战，以及开发多功能诊疗一体化平台的未来展望。总体而言，使用碳点基纳米材料代表了一种有前景的新兴策略，用于克服神经生物学屏障，并推动下一代纳米治疗药物的发展，以管理神经退行性疾病。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统整合了碳点纳米材料穿越血脑屏障并用于神经退行性疾病诊疗的最新进展，对ALS纳米治疗策略具有转化参考价值。

items.title: Assessing the metabolic rate in patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, Progressive Muscular Atrophy, and Primary Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: To determine whether resting energy expenditure (REE) differs between patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), progressive muscular atrophy (PMA), and primary lateral sclerosis (PLS). Patients with ALS, PMA, and PLS were enrolled between 2017 and 2021 in a prospective cross-sectional study. REE was measured by indirect calorimetry. Body composition was assessed using air displacement plethysmography and used to calculate predicted resting energy expenditure (pREE). Metabolic index (MI) was defined as mREE relative to pREE and expressed as a percentage. Differences between disease categories were assessed using multivariable regression adjusted for sex, age, fat-free mass, fat mass, height, and smoking status. In total, 79 patients with ALS, 33 with PMA, and 30 with PLS were included. MI of ≥110% was observed in 55.7% of patients with ALS, 27.3% with PMA, and 26.7% with PLS. After adjustment, MI differed significantly between disease subtypes ( p = 0.019), with the highest mean observed in ALS (108.5%, 95% CI 105.8-111.1), followed by PMA (105.9%, 95% CI 102.6-109.3) and PLS (103.2%, CI 99.8 -106.6). Metabolic measures were not statistically correlated with disease-specific clinical characteristics. Our findings suggest that metabolic phenotype varies across MND subtypes. In the absence of non-neurological controls, findings are best interpreted as indicating that MI-defined hypermetabolism is most prevalent in ALS; however, whether metabolic rate is increased in PMA or PLS relative to the general population remains unknown.
items.titleZh: 评估肌萎缩侧索硬化、进行性肌萎缩和原发性侧索硬化患者的代谢率
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性横断面研究比较了ALS、PMA和PLS患者的静息能量消耗。以代谢指数（实测/预测静息能量消耗）衡量，ALS患者高代谢（MI≥110%）比例最高（55.7%），PMA为27.3%，PLS为26.7%；校正混杂因素后，ALS的MI均值也最高。代谢指标与疾病特异性临床特征无显著相关。由于没有非神经系统对照组，研究只能说明高代谢在ALS中最突出，不能判断PMA或PLS相对一般人群是否存在代谢率升高。
items.insight: 该研究把ALS的代谢改变放在运动神经元病谱系中比较，提示高代谢并非所有亚型共有，而是以ALS最为明显。对ALS研究者而言，这有助于把代谢表型作为疾病异质性、分层和营养干预研究的候选维度，同时提醒在缺乏健康对照时不能把PMA/PLS的代谢差异直接外推为人群水平异常。

aiRead.keyFinding: 校正性别、年龄、去脂体重、脂肪量、身高和吸烟状况后，代谢指数在ALS、PMA和PLS之间存在显著差异，ALS最高；MI≥110%在ALS中占55.7%，高于PMA的27.3%和PLS的26.7%。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏非神经系统对照组，无法判断PMA或PLS相对一般人群的代谢率是否升高；代谢指标与疾病特异性临床特征无显著相关；样本量有限。

items.abstractZh: 旨在确定肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）、进行性肌萎缩（PMA）和原发性侧索硬化（PLS）患者的静息能量消耗（REE）是否存在差异。研究于2017年至2021年间前瞻性横断面纳入ALS、PMA和PLS患者。通过间接测热法测量REE。使用空气置换体积描记法评估身体成分，并用于计算预测静息能量消耗（pREE）。代谢指数（MI）定义为实测REE相对于pREE的比值，以百分比表示。采用多变量回归评估不同疾病类别之间的差异，并校正性别、年龄、去脂体重、脂肪量、身高和吸烟状况。共纳入79例ALS、33例PMA和30例PLS患者。MI≥110%见于55.7%的ALS患者、27.3%的PMA患者和26.7%的PLS患者。校正后，MI在不同疾病亚型之间差异显著（p=0.019），ALS均值最高（108.5%，95%CI 105.8-111.1），其次为PMA（105.9%，95%CI 102.6-109.3）和PLS（103.2%，95%CI 99.8-106.6）。代谢指标与疾病特异性临床特征无统计学相关性。我们的研究结果提示，代谢表型在运动神经元病亚型之间存在差异。在缺乏非神经系统对照的情况下，结果最好解释为：由MI定义的高代谢在ALS中最为普遍；然而，相对于一般人群，PMA或PLS中代谢率是否升高仍不清楚。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以新近前瞻性队列数据细化运动神经元病亚型间的代谢表型差异，提示ALS相关高代谢具有亚型特异性，对ALS代谢机制和营养干预分层具有转化参考价值。

items.title: Statin Exposure and Survival Outcomes in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis in an Asian Cohort.
items.summary: Data from Asian cohorts on whether statin therapy affects amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) progression are limited. We examined whether statin exposure was associated with ALS disease duration or tracheostomy-free survival in a multiethnic Asian ALS cohort. Data from patients diagnosed with ALS between 2012 and 2025 were retrospectively reviewed. Patients were categorized as "ever" or "never" statin users for primary analyses, and as "never," "former," or "current" users at diagnosis for additional analyses. Disease duration was defined as time from symptom onset to death, and tracheostomy-free survival as time from symptom onset to tracheostomy or death without tracheostomy. Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression analyses evaluated associations between statin exposure and both outcomes. Additional analyses examined statin discontinuation after diagnosis using time-varying exposures. Sensitivity analyses excluded post-diagnosis imitators and applied 30-, 90-, and 180-day lags. Among 103 ALS patients, 27 (26.2%) had ever received statins. Statin exposure was not significantly associated with disease duration (hazard ratio [HR]: 1.42, 95% CI: 0.64-3.14, p = 0.387) or tracheostomy-free survival (HR: 1.04, 95% CI: 0.50-2.18, p = 0.913). Post-diagnosis statin discontinuation was associated with shorter survival in a time-varying analysis (HR: 6.52, 95% CI: 1.48-28.74, p = 0.013), although this finding was hypothesis-generating. Sensitivity analyses did not show statistically significant associations. In this multiethnic Asian ALS cohort, statin exposure was not significantly associated with disease duration or tracheostomy-free survival. These findings add to the evidence that statins do not need to be discontinued due to ALS diagnosis. Larger studies are needed to define this association.
items.titleZh: 亚洲队列中他汀类药物暴露与肌萎缩侧索硬化生存结局的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性观察研究分析了103例亚洲ALS患者，发现他汀类药物暴露与疾病持续时间或无气管造口生存无显著关联。诊断后停用他汀与更短生存相关，但该结果仅为假设生成性质，敏感性分析未证实。总体提示不应仅因ALS诊断而停用他汀类药物，但需更大规模研究验证。
items.insight: 该研究为亚洲多民族ALS队列提供了他汀类药物与生存结局的观察性数据，有助于回应临床中因ALS诊断而停用他汀的常见顾虑。尽管主要分析为阴性，但诊断后停用他汀与更短生存的时变分析信号值得进一步在更大样本和前瞻性设计中验证，以避免因反向因果或混杂导致误判。

items.abstractZh: 来自亚洲队列的关于他汀类药物治疗是否影响肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）进展的数据有限。我们在一个多种族亚洲ALS队列中考察了他汀类药物暴露是否与ALS疾病持续时间或无气管造口生存相关。回顾性分析了2012年至2025年间诊断为ALS的患者数据。主要分析中，患者被分为“曾使用”或“从未使用”他汀类药物；在额外分析中，按诊断时状态分为“从未使用”“既往使用”或“当前使用”。疾病持续时间定义为从症状发作到死亡的时间，无气管造口生存定义为从症状发作到气管造口或未行气管造口死亡的时间。采用Kaplan-Meier和Cox回归分析评估他汀类药物暴露与两种结局之间的关联。额外分析使用时变暴露考察诊断后停用他汀类药物的情况。敏感性分析排除了诊断后模拟者，并应用30天、90天和180天的滞后。在103例ALS患者中，27例（26.2%）曾接受他汀类药物。他汀类药物暴露与疾病持续时间（风险比[HR]：1.42，95%置信区间[CI]：0.64-3.14，p=0.387）或无气管造口生存（HR：1.04，95%CI：0.50-2.18，p=0.913）均无显著关联。在时变分析中，诊断后停用他汀类药物与更短的生存期相关（HR：6.52，95%CI：1.48-28.74，p=0.013），尽管该发现属于假设生成性质。敏感性分析未显示具有统计学显著性的关联。在这个多种族亚洲ALS队列中，他汀类药物暴露与疾病持续时间或无气管造口生存无显著关联。这些发现补充了证据，表明不应因ALS诊断而停用他汀类药物。需要更大规模的研究来明确这一关联。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2012-2025年亚洲多民族ALS队列，新近补充了他汀暴露与ALS生存结局的观察性证据，对临床用药决策具有直接转化参考价值。
